decisions.statement: A note and a row are matched by the name the sheet states.
An entry is carried only where the row's account of it is the opening of the note's.
An entry the row states further than the note is left as the row states it.
A passage the body does not hold once refuses the change before anything lands.
Nothing here takes a note away.

definition: what a note holds of a sheet's history, carried into the row the game reads
